sloka: तर्कयाम् आस सीता इति कारणैः उपपादिभिः ।ह्रियमाणा तदा तेन रक्षसा काम रूपिणा ॥५-१५-२७॥
transliteration: tarkayām āsa sītā iti kāraṇaiḥ upapādibhiḥ ।hriyamāṇā tadā tena rakṣasā kāma rūpiṇā ॥5-15-27॥

translations.english: Beholding the form of the largeeyed lady, Hanuman guessed, 'This is similar to the form seen while the demon was kidnapping her'.
